summary: Verified the 3 RAW findings against HEAD 04603fa87 AND against the GLOBAL axios response interceptor (resources/js/bootstrap.js:178-280), which the RAW report failed to account for. app.js (admin entrypoint) imports ./bootstrap (line 9) and OutboxOverviewComponent chunks into admin-shell (router/modules/observabilityRoutes.js:6/20-22), so the interceptor IS active on this surface. The interceptor surfaces a visible vue-toastification toast for statuses {408,425,429,502,503,504} (bootstrap.js:192) plus 5xx (bootstrap.js:250 -> 'Service indisponible'), and critical-4xx ONLY for _CRITICAL_4XX_PATTERNS=['/api/admin/item','/api/admin/fiscal/'] (lines 135-138). The outbox endpoints are NOT in that allowlist. RECONCILED TRUTH TABLE for outbox POST/GET: 5xx/502/503/504/429 -> global toast shown (NOT silent); 403/400/404/422 + network-error(status 0) -> silent (reject, no toast); 200 success -> no feedback (interceptor is pass-through). CONSEQUENCE: RAW Finding 1/3's headline premise ('a 500/worker-down failure is invisible') is FALSE for the dominant cases. NET RESULT: Finding 2 (destructive ->delete() with no confirmation) CONFIRMED P2 — interceptor is post-response and irrelevant to a pre-POST confirm dialog; this is the strongest finding. Finding 1 NARROWED to P3 — the surviving truths are (a) no SUCCESS confirmation on retry/drain, and (b) residual silence ONLY on 403/non-critical-4xx + network errors, plus the global toast is transient (6s, line 270) and bucket-debounced (3s, line 263) where a permanent observability dashboard arguably warrants a persistent banner like the siblings' errorMessage role=alert. Finding 3 DROPPED — folded into Finding 1; a 5xx GET DOES toast so 'stale data with no indication' is false for the main case and the thin residual overlaps Finding 1. Backend routes confirmed (routes/api.php:1175-1181); controller app/Http/Controllers/Admin/Observability/SyncOverviewController.php (outboxDrainFailed:417, ->delete():429, SAFE-BY-DEFAULT older_than_hours<1 reject at 419-422). All 28 observability_outbox.* i18n keys resolve in fr.json (0 raw labels, validated programmatically). Sibling contrast confirmed: CashOverviewComponent.vue catch@387; StockRuptureDashboardComponent.vue errorMessage role=alert lines 65-71/314 set@522/570. None of these files are in CLAUDE.md §7 frozen-zone. Path corrections vs RAW: CashOverview at resources/js/components/admin/cashOverview/, StockRupture at resources/js/components/admin/stock/, controller under app/Http/Controllers/Admin/Observability/.

findings.title: Destructive purge fires on single click with no confirmation dialog
findings.grep_evidence: VERIFIED: drainFailed() (lines 382-391) posts to /admin/observability/outbox/drain-failed {older_than_hours:24} with no window.confirm/modal/swal — grep -nE 'confirm|window.confirm|modal|\$swal' on the component returns NO match. Backend outboxDrainFailed at app/Http/Controllers/Admin/Observability/SyncOverviewController.php:417 executes hard DB::table('failed_jobs')->...->delete() at line 429 (grep-confirmed). Button correctly disabled when failedJobs.count===0 (template line 70: ':disabled="draining || failedJobs.count === 0"') but is a one-click irreversible delete when failures exist. Backend has a SAFE-BY-DEFAULT guard rejecting older_than_hours<1 (lines 419-422), but the destructive single-click on >=24h-old failed_jobs still proceeds unconfirmed. The global axios interceptor (bootstrap.js:178-280) is POST-response and cannot prevent this — it is irrelevant to a pre-POST confirmation.
findings.recommendation: Gate drainFailed() behind a confirmation (window.confirm or project modal) stating how many records will be permanently deleted before issuing the POST.

findings.element: Actualiser / Réessayer les échecs / Vider les échecs (loadAll, retryFailed, drainFailed)
findings.title: No success confirmation, and residual silent failure on 403/non-critical-4xx + network errors; transient toast unsuitable for a persistent observability surface
findings.grep_evidence: VERIFIED + RECONCILED: loadAll(358-372)/retryFailed(373-381)/drainFailed(382-392) use try/finally with NO local catch (the lone component-level catch at line 397 is inside formatTimestamp). HOWEVER the RAW '500/worker-down invisible' premise is FALSE: global interceptor at resources/js/bootstrap.js:178-280 (active here — app.js:9 imports ./bootstrap; component chunks into admin-shell per router/modules/observabilityRoutes.js:6) toasts TOAST_STATUSES={408,425,429,502,503,504} (line 192) and 5xx (line 250 'Service indisponible'). Surviving TRUE residual: (a) NO success confirmation on any of the three actions (interceptor is error-only, line 179 passes responses through); (b) 403/400/404/422 + network-error(status 0) on outbox stay SILENT because outbox endpoints are NOT in _CRITICAL_4XX_PATTERNS=['/api/admin/item','/api/admin/fiscal/'] (lines 135-138, fall-through reject at 200-202); (c) even when a toast fires it is transient (6s timeout, line 270) and bucket-debounced (3s gap, line 263) — adequate for POS bursts but a dashboard whose entire purpose is observability arguably warrants a persistent banner like siblings StockRuptureDashboardComponent.vue (errorMessage role=alert, lines 65-71, set 522/570) and CashOverviewComponent.vue (catch@387).
findings.recommendation: Add a brief success confirmation after loadAll() in retryFailed/drainFailed, and a local catch that sets a persistent errorMessage banner (role=alert, matching StockRupture lines 65-71) so 403/network failures and stale fetches are visible beyond the transient global toast.
